name: omnibill/pennylane
description: Omnibill Pennylane: Pennylane's accounting for omnisense/omnibill's journal-entries and contacts contracts - ledger entries posted to a journal (found by code) on ledger accounts (found by number and VAT rate), read back and listed; company and individual customers and suppliers created, updated, read, listed - through Pennylane's Company API v2 with a company token or a partner app's OAuth token (OAuth helper included). Pennylane's API contract terms (internal use unless API partner) carried in its capabilities.
